name: Cathedral and Churches of Echmiatsin and the Archaeological Site of Zvartnots
description: Near the town of Vagharshapat in Armenia, this site pairs Echmiatsin, one of the world's oldest cathedrals, with the ruins of Zvartnots, a seventh-century church. Zvartnots was unusual for its circular outer wall and tiers of interior piers beneath a dome. Today you can walk among its broken columns and carved stones, and see how Armenian domed churches took shape.
